property_summary: For any amount and any counterparty, if sendTo completes successfully then the counterparty actually received exactly the sent amount; the mutant's unchecked low-level call returns success even when the receiver reverts, so value is silently lost while sendTo still reports success.
change_summary: Replace the low-level transfer with a call so a failed transfer no longer reverts and any fallback logic of the receiver is exercised.
